Team — forwarding request from NovaMed. Key facts captured below and in the attached SOW.

- Ask: consolidate billing to one invoice per quarter, payment Net-60 from invoice date, for a 12-month term.
- Potential concessions from buyer: modest prepay for Q1 or 2% early-pay credit in exchange for agreeable SLAs.
- Unknown: expected quarterly spend band (asked them to confirm).
- Attachments: NovaMed_SOW_v3.pdf (attached), HubSpot deal link included below.

Why this needs exec attention: our standard T&C is monthly billing, Net-30. Quarterly consolidated invoices + Net-60 materially shifts cash flow and increases DSO. We should consider: credit risk, reserve, upfront partial prepay, or applying a finance charge.

Proposed options for approval (sorted by risk mitigations):
A) Approve as-is for entire term if NovaMed provides an up-front prepayment equal to Q1 estimated usage (reduces our exposure).
B) Approve with Net-60 for first two quarters as a pilot; revert to monthly billing after pilot unless otherwise approved.
C) Approve for term but apply a 1.5% finance charge on invoices with Net-60 (or offer 2% early-pay credit for payment within Net-15).

Until we have the quarterly spend, option B seems reasonable. Asking for a decision on which option is acceptable and any guardrails (credit limit, required SOW signature, contract amendment).

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/31245/RDW-2026-1134

Jordan
